description: This horizontal bar chart, presented at a slight diagonal angle, illustrates the "Number of Participants" associated with various categories under the label "Criterion." The vertical axis contains the categories, labeled "Criterion," and lists seven items sorted in descending order based on their corresponding values. The horizontal value axis is labeled "Number of Participants" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 2. The chart displays seven horizontal bars, each representing a specific criterion and colored in a gradient transitioning from dark purple at the top to yellow-green at the bottom. Most bars are visually emphasized by exact numeric annotations placed at their right ends. The longest bar, representing "Relevant FCs," is dark purple and extends to the 6 mark on the value axis. This is followed by "FC Summary" (dark blue, annotated as 5), "Relevance Explanation" (teal, annotated as 3), "Clarity and Simplicity" (green-teal, annotated as 3), and "Overall Summary" (medium green, annotated as 2). The shortest bars represent "Filters" (light green) and "Veracity Explanation" (yellow-green), both of which are annotated with a value of 1.
